description: A notification goes to any active subscription that asked for its kind, whatever its id (SUBS-02)
old: Targets(n, k) == {s \in Subs: phase[s] = "active" /\ cur[s] = n /\ k \in acked[s]}
new: Targets(n, k) == {s \in Subs: phase[s] = "active" /\ k \in acked[s]}

description: A notification is delivered before the acknowledgment, by what was asked (SUBS-01)
old: Targets(n, k) == {s \in Subs: phase[s] = "active" /\ cur[s] = n /\ k \in acked[s]}
new: Targets(n, k) == {s \in Subs: phase[s] \in {"pending", "active"} /\ cur[s] = n /\ k \in asked[s] \cup acked[s]}

description: An acknowledgment naming more than was asked is taken as it is
An acknowledgment of nothing asked leaves the subscription active
A cancelled subscription keeps taking notifications
A result after the end is reported again
new:
Final(n) ==
    IF \E s \in Subs: cur[s] = n

description: A result is treated as an abrupt end and listened to again
old:
THEN /\ Ends(OwnerOf(n), n)
         /\ final' = [final EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
         /\ UNCHANGED <<cur, asked, acked, tries, next, stdio, up, owner, ackSeen, allowed, ghosts>>
new:
THEN /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![OwnerOf(n)] = "waiting"]
         /\ over' = [over EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
         /\ final' = [final EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
         /\ UNCHANGED <<cur, asked, acked, tries, next, stdio, up, owner, ackSeen, allowed, told, ghosts>>

description: A listen goes out again while the stdio process is down (SUBS-05)
The process exit leaves its listens running (SUBS-05)
old: /\ phase' = [s \in Subs |-> IF s \in Live THEN (IF tries[s] < MaxTries THEN "waiting" ELSE "ended") ELSE phase[s]]

description: Giving up after the last try doesn't tell the host
new:
ELSE /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![s] = "ended"]
         /\ over' = [over EXCEPT ![cur[s]] = TRUE]
         /\ UNCHANGED <<tries, told>>

description: A subscription waiting after an abrupt end never listens again (SUBS-05)
Notifications are checked against what the subscription asked, not what was acknowledged
old: Targets(n, k) == {s \in Subs: phase[s] = "active" /\ cur[s] = n /\ k \in acked[s]}
new: Targets(n, k) == {s \in Subs: phase[s] = "active" /\ cur[s] = n /\ k \in asked[s]}
